_about: registry_len() double-counted anonymous styles: every call to intern_anonymous_style inserts an `__anon__/<hash>` entry into the named id_to_name vec AND a parallel entry into the anon_styles map. The fuzz invariant summed both, so 46 distinct anon styles registered during one render were charged as 92 entries against the INTERN_SLACK=64 budget and tripped the leak assertion.
_fix: fix(style): drop anon double-count from theme::registry_len
